touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Manby qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST EDITH and Cross in St Edith's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Manby: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Manby offers CHURCH OF ST EDITH, Cross in St Edith's churchyard, CHURCH OF ST MARY within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST EDITH
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST EDITH and Cross in St Edith's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
